summary: TLS 1.3 is widely used and offers better security and privacy than TLS 1.2, so new protocols that use TLS must require TLS 1.3. This best current practice does not apply to DTLS, because DTLS 1.3 is not yet widely deployed. It updates RFC 9325.

eli5.summary: If a new club is being started, it should only accept the newest, safest membership card. Older cards still work for old clubs, but new clubs should not take them.
